description: Mercury air transport simulator provides a stochastic agent-based air-transport simulator representing passengers, aircraft, airports and the network manager for performance assessment. The provider is Luis Delgado; Gérald Gurtner; Michal Weiszer; Tatjana Bolić; Andrew Cook. Geographical and temporal coverage: The article describes European-level air transportation and a simulator developed over multiple research projects; scenario dates and resolution are configurable. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: not stated for the model; the describing article (TU Delft open journal) is under a Creative Commons licence. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-bluesky, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
